Record notes

Eight methods for invoices, cash, paid-service coordination and Gmail review with an offline receipt gate.

Version 0.3.1 includes 8 complete skill procedures. Complete methods and synthetic fixtures; no client records or account connectors.

Requirements: Python 3.9+ for reconciliation; POSIX file locking for optional Gmail gate; Your own source records and explicitly authorized communication providers.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add solo-service-operations@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from 9d932e599c75a2d5fa7e7bafe35207f13389e98c. SHA-256: 51764fc515c3f43032aa7acbf1852ad98ef35df3c4f7a2ccb360392825095dc4.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
